_README: Edit these values for each client, then run: python3 _build/build.py && python3 _build/qa.py. Values marked SAMPLE must be replaced before launch. Keep demo_mode true until real client details are in; it adds noindex to every page and the yellow website demo banner. Colours (#rrggbb): accent = the brand colour used for buttons and highlight panels (it sits behind dark text, so it must be a light, bright colour; the build stops if it is too dark); field_2 = the second panel colour (light); field_3 = the deep panel colour (dark, behind light text). logo: path to the client's logo, e.g. assets/img/client/logo.png (transparent PNG best); empty = built-in mark + name. services: remove any slug the client does not offer, then fix any sentences listed in _build/removed-service-mentions.txt. prices: starting price per service shown on the treatment menu, the finder and each service page (set to null to show 'Priced at consultation'). photos: the client's own photos only (see _build/photos.py); hero_photo and category_photos fill the big picture slots (otherwise the drawn artwork is used). provider_line: who performs treatments, written by the client and checked by their medical director. intro: false turns the opening animation off; intro_scope 'all' plays it on whichever page a visitor lands on first, 'home' limits it to the home page. finder: false removes the treatment finder.
provider_line: Injectable treatments are performed by registered nurses and physicians, under the direction of our medical director. Every treatment starts with a consultation.

prices._README: SAMPLE prices (CAD). Starting price per service as the client wants it shown, with the unit. Use null for 'Priced at consultation'.
